title: The Rainy Night
answer: A, the gardener. It rained all night, so if he'd really been out in the greenhouse his boots would be muddy. They were spotless.

beats.line: Mr. Hale was found dead in his study. Three people were home. One of them is lying.
It rained all night at Hale Manor.
Suspect A. The gardener says he was working in the greenhouse all night.
Suspect B. The niece says she was asleep upstairs.
Suspect C. The butler says he was polishing silver in the kitchen.
But the detective noticed one thing. The gardener's boots were spotless.
So, who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
